best_parts: nodes time/pi/ar/sd/dth: one continuous family and clinic case (Rhea, Meera, village clinic) so each probe is a real decision moment
nodes time_t, time_s, bt_t1, bt_t2, pi_t1, pi_t2, dth_t1, dth_t2: each trap gets its own 'Tempting because... But...' feedback tied to that option's wrong model, plus a targeted sure_note
nodes deep1/deep2/bt_dp: unverified material kept in flagged deeper nodes only, entered by choice
flaws: keys are the first button on every probe (time, bt, bt2, pi, pi2, ar, sd, dth, dth2) and often the longest (tim2, ar, sd): findable by position and form (DP1)
no retry after a first miss: a wrong pick gets the answer at once, so no hint ladder or delayed re-test credit; hints exist only on request
node bt2 repeats bt with the same traps and 'ipsilateral' handed over in the stem, so it tests recall of the previous feedback; dth2 likewise re-asks the figures dth_t1/dth_t2 just revealed

soft fidelity stretches: tim2_ok/tim2_t2 say a shunt is 'not described as the routine first step' (not in K49/K50); ar_t1 sure_note says 'follow-up is lifelong' on K62; key label 'occur in 40-50%' is stronger than K63 'can have'

gates: G1: node b_aorta (claims []) states 'the Blalock-Taussig shunt starts one branch off the aorta', an anatomy fact in no claim (and imprecise for a right-sided shunt); b_aorta also asserts 'a shunt must bring systemic blood to the lungs'. t_neo ('defects are present from birth') and a_endo ('repair closes the hole where infection might settle') also state uncited facts/mechanisms
best_parts: feedback pattern in t_neo, t_school, b_svc, r_vsd, r_inf, w_vsd, w_lv, k_abs, k_cva, m_swap: 'You picked X: tempting because... What it misses...' then the claim; names the wrong model, why it tempts, refutes (best trap feedback of the three, once the added facts are removed)
key position is shuffled across probes (first, third, third, third, second, third), so the key is not findable by position

node open/wrap: 'misses are useful' productive-failure framing and a recap that names the pattern (each answer hides a qualifier); note 'Your misses showed the pattern' is wrong for a learner with no misses
flaws: node r_why asks why regurgitation follows repair straight after r_ok already stated K60, so the answer is read off the preceding feedback

node a2: option 'None after a good repair' repeats the trap a1 just refuted and 'Under 1%' is eliminated the same way; both distractors are dominated by the learner's immediate prior knowledge; k2 distractors are likewise eliminable from the 68% just shown in k_ok
no retry after a miss and a single hint level; TR18 and TR19 are probed only once in the segment

gates: G1: node bt_TR19_b says 'a vein-to-pulmonary-artery link belongs to another operation' (added fact the bank does not hold, on a K54 claim that says only what BT connects); node wrap says 'a lifelong watch for arrhythmia' on K62 ('can occur after repair'), a stretched qualifier; arr_TR21_a/b sure_note repeats 'lifelong risks'
best_parts: nodes rep/rep_2, bt/bt_2, pi/pi_2, arr/arr_2, dth/dth_2: real hint ladder (first miss gives feedback and a retry, the clone probe then gives the answer), the only variant that follows the DP9 retry rule

nodes pi_why and dth_why: 'explain it to yourself' and 'why is abscess not the top killer' probes make the learner reason about frequency and cause rather than recall a number; dth_why_t2 refutes by arithmetic from K65/K66
node arr_n: options Under 1% / About 5% / 40-50% form a gradient, so a learner who knows risk remains but not its size has a tempting wrong option (better than b's a2)
flaws: nodes rep_TR18_a/b, bt_TR19_a/b, pi_TR20_a/b, arr_TR21_a/b, dth_TR22_a/b: both traps of a probe share one feedback node, so half the learners get refutation of the wrong model (e.g. neonatal-repair picker told 'a bigger child is safer'; aorta picker told 'starts from an artery, not a vein'; cure picker told about endocarditis); this breaks one-error-per-option diagnosis and the R9 signal
nodes bt_hint and pi_hint: hints remove distractors or name the RVOT repair, so they sit close to giving the answer
keys are again the first button on nearly every probe (arr_n and dth_why vary); second-miss feedback (arr_TR21_b, dth_TR22_b) drops the 'why tempting' step
unverified palliation probes pal_q, bt_q2 sit in deeper nodes and are flagged, which is allowed, but the core path has no re-test of TR18/TR19 outside them

merge_ideas: Build on a's case thread (Rhea, Arun, Meera, clinic) and its clean flagged deeper nodes
Use b's option-specific 'You picked X: tempting because... what it misses' feedback and shuffled key positions, removing the uncited aorta/birth/infection statements
Add c's retry ladder (first miss: feedback and retry, second miss: answer) on the key probes time, bt, pi, ar and dth
Replace a's bt2 and dth2 with c's pi_why self-explanation and dth_why reasoning probes, and use c's gradient numeric options (under 1% / about 5% / 40-50%)
Keep one feedback node per distractor; never pool two traps into one node as c does
